entries.reason: export the class CharonImageAnimation: its methods are built in Graphics/ImageIOAnimation134.m, but the 6.1.3 library links the class symbol local (nm of the built libGraphicsBackports.dylib shows _OBJC_CLASS_$_CharonImageAnimation as s, not S), and the registry check counts only exported class symbols
entries.effect: until the class symbol is exported, the registry check reports the class as not built; the two animation functions are unaffected
entries.source: no SDK header declares this name; the band is this port's own, the release whose object carries it, and the two functions it carries are first held at 13.4 (tools/cache-index/first-rung.lua over the 54 held rungs, 2026-10-18); the export state measured by nm on the gate's 6.1.3 build (2026-10-18)
